exact_statement: For a physical query in block j of any Boolean disjoint substitution, with q_j fixed under the query, child core surpluses S_K=K I-H and exact outer corrections C_b, put A_b=q_j S_K(g_j^b), M_b=sum_(l!=j) q_l^b S_K(g_l)-C_b, U_b=A_b-max(0,-M_b). If U_b>=0 and e=Delta H(F)-K Inf>0, payment using exclusively the unused queried-child owner is feasible iff e<=B=(U_0+U_1)/2; the exact minimum fraction is e/B. For the eight alternative actual queries of h(g^6) or J(g^6), g six-bit negative on{0,1,2}, j=0 or1,i=0 or2, h negative on{0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, J=-h(x xor1), all M_b>0 and e<(2/5)B at K4 for J and K9/2 for h. Their exact largest e/B is the J/block0/inner2 case and lies between1/3 and2/5. On that case query surviving inner0 in the nonconstant core child: the old conditional debit D0=2e1 is retained, D0+e2<(3/5)B_grand, and remaining mean selected bank equals incoming selected bank after D0 minus Delta C2. The root constant-core branch keeps reach1/2, selected debit0 and its complete nonconstant full terminal. The attempted same all-eight K4 owner is refuted by S4(h(g^6))<0. No universal availability, full physical tree payment or FEI bound is asserted.
